name: 04976 · Skowhegan, ME
findings: ZIP 04976 (Skowhegan) has 29 nonprofit organizations. 10 of them (34%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 9 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (50% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 04976 (Skowhegan) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 04976 (Skowhegan) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 41% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 12 organizations here; 17% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find groups to join now, including outside formal organizations?
